sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Pros first: fuller texture helps real meals. That practical fullness is one reason it can work beyond the numbers. Easy whole-grain staple to use regularly. Plain rolled oats are cheap, familiar, and realistic for repeated use, which matters for an everyday grain. Plain oats start unsweetened. That gives them a cleaner baseline than sweetened instant oatmeal products, which are excluded from this entry.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: Downsides next: not enough extra payoff for a top slot. The wider food still has to earn its place through more than one angle. The bowl can get worse fast with sugary add-ons. The plain ingredient is solid, but common preparation choices can change the real meal a lot. Texture and tolerance can be barriers. Some people dislike the texture or do not tolerate oats especially well, which is a real usability downside for a staple food.
